text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Believe makes her move! Believe surges ahead!!
Holding off Calstone Light O, Durandal, and every other speedster on the track, right now!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!!!!
The fastest queen who stayed true to her conviction, her name is Believe!!
Right here at Nakayama Racecourse, she reigns supreme!!”

Bathed in a storm of cheers, I think to myself:
First, I need to—
choice_data_list: (I should apologize for what happened at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen...)
(I'll have to apologize for what happened at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen...)

text_block_list.text:
Back then, I truly believed that Believe's running was "complete."
I even thought it was the very essence, the absolute pinnacle.
—There is no way on earth that could happen.

Today's run without a doubt taught me that.
A solid foundation that will never break no matter what happens.
And the relentless devotion piled high, higher and higher upon it.

All that remains is the resolve to see everything through.
As long as I can hold true to that conviction.

The realm she can reach—
there is no way it has any limits!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Is that a sigh?
Or are you just completely exhausted?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Both.
And my motivation is high, too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm completely exhausted, and it's overwhelmingly frustrating. But still—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Even so, there is something I must tell you, without fail.
"And there, in the winner's circle—a place reserved only for the victor—Believe received immense praise."
Even amidst the unending applause and cheers, Believe responded with her usual composed manner from beginning to end, butâ

...A low, raspy, yet
strikingly clear man's voice roared.
Believe walks over toward the stands with a somewhat floaty, dazed air about her.

And so, gazing upon "him"
standing proudly there with legs apart—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Did you come... all the way from America?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Just to...
Just to watch my race?

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: I came to see how you're handling your work.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Thank you very much.
For letting my grandchild take on work like this.
choice_data_list: No, this is the result of her own hard work.

text_block_list.text:
...A large, deeply wrinkled hand
reaches straight out.
And then—

And Believe hastily smoothed down her hair,
which had been ruffled and messy
from being stroked—
